finding.title: Incorrect Access Control
finding.sink: Access to node2Data, indices, onStackFlag, nodeStack, resSubData
finding.trigger: Access to elements in vectors without bounds checking
finding.assumptions: The vectors node1Data, link1, nextLink1, node2Data, indices, onStackFlag, nodeStack, resSubData are assumed to be correctly initialized and have valid sizes. However, the code does not explicitly check if the indices accessed in node2Data, indices, onStackFlag, nodeStack, resSubData are within their bounds.

finding.title: Resource Management Error
finding.assumptions: The size of node1Data is not controlled or limited. If node1Data is large enough, nodeStack could grow indefinitely, leading to a memory exhaustion.

finding.title: Buffer Over-read
finding.assumptions: The indices accessed in node2Data and indices are not checked against their bounds. If currentLink is out of range, this could lead to a buffer over-read.
